🚨 BREAKING: Tesla Cybercab Secures Key EPA Approval for 2026 Deployment

Tesla has officially received an EPA Certificate of Conformity for its Cybercab robotaxi, marking a major regulatory milestone.

The certificate confirms the vehicle meets all federal emissions standards under the Clean Air Act as a zero-emission electric vehicle. Issued to Tesla Inc. with an effective date of May 26, 2026, it legally clears the Cybercab for introduction into U.S. commerce. 

This paves the way for broader deployment of Tesla’s autonomous robotaxi fleet.

I'm back home after a whirlwind 2 week trip through Europe, including Switzerland, Austria, the Czech Republic & Germany, including stops for the wonderful @Tesla Takeover Europe event in Flachau & a memorable tour of Giga Berlin along side 3 legendary Gigafactory drone pilots!

I visited independent workshops working to bring @Cybertruck to Europe, enthusiasts from all over the continent celebrating a brighter & exciting future, meeting with amazing @Tesla employees making the mission happen day-in & day-out, & people in industry who helped me better understand the complexities of fleet management, an under appreciated topic which is critical for @Tesla to solve to make @robotaxi service work and scale effectively.

Although many people helped make my trip so much fun, there are a few that went well above & beyond, so I wanted to acknowledge them publicly with a heartfelt "Thank you"!

Peter Hostettler @pithostettler was my main guide, driver, interpreter, camera operator & great friend throughout the entire 2 weeks. He has been a Patreon supporter since the very beginning of my channel & I could not think of a better human being to tour Europe with!

Ondrej Bacina @OndrejBacina showed me the beauty of the Czech Republic along with its rich history & love of all Tech things! Ondrej is the biggest YouTuber (piped.video/@ondrej.bacina) in the Czech Republic, educating a wide audience about many companies offering EV's including in-depth car reviews & expert opinions about autonomy & organizing group tours in the USA for people to see & experience factories, products (like FSD) & sites related to Tech.

Of course the members of the @TeslaClubAT & especially @SeefyCar who made my time at Flachau for the Takeover Europe very special, but also a @Tesla community icon & perhaps the biggest supporter of them all, John Stringer @teslaownersSV who helped at Flachau, Giga Berlin & the upcoming X Takeover event at Giga Texas!

Also, David from @teslawelt who I've had the pleasure of meeting & working with on both sides of the Atlantic! Thanks for the great "4 Gigafactory Drone Operators" interview at Giga Berlin!

Finally, getting to meet in person three of the best drone operators covering @Tesla Gigafactories, Andreas & Robert @wolfpackberlin & the great Tobias Lindh @tobilindh ... what a thrill talking with the people who inspired me to cover Giga Texas and touring the factory they worked so hard covering & sharing with the world from their unique perspectives!

We have a great community with truly gifted people all over the world & this trip only reinforces my opinion we have a very bright future worth being excited about! What a trip!

I'll be back in the air over Giga Texas soon ... just wanted to take a moment and reflect on an impactful 2 weeks for me& say "Thank you" to all who helped make it so!
@lifeatGFBB

Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt)

Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe in new interview:

"Later this year, we'll have full supervised point-to-point, which will be very similar to @Tesla's FSD. That will roll out to all of our Gen 2 vehicles and, of course, R2. Next year, we'll allow it to go unsupervised, so you can take your eyes off the road. The next step is achieving full capability for the vehicle to drive itself with no one in the car. We've been developing that for a while for our personal vehicles, but we also see it unlocking new business models, robotaxi being one of them.

We took the decision to parter with Uber so we could focus on the tech and leverage them for their access to a big distribution channel. They're really a category of one. There's no one quite at their scale or reach."

Full interview: piped.video/watch?v=wP61dCtO…

Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

🚀 Exclusive Interview with André Thierig @AndrThie, Senior Director of Manufacturing at Tesla Giga Berlin!

We sat down for a wide-ranging conversation covering the factory’s incredible journey, major recent milestones, manufacturing breakthroughs, factory culture, and what’s next for Europe’s most important Tesla plant.

In this interview we discuss:
• Giga Berlin’s evolution and the meaning behind producing the millionth vehicle
• The new $250 million investment in the 4680 cell factory (18 GWh capacity + 1,500+ jobs)
• 20% Model Y production increase starting in July — what changed operationally
• Giga casting, autonomous vehicle movement from the light tunnel to outbound yard, and other manufacturing innovations
• The advanced paint shop and how it enables colors like Quicksilver and Midnight Cherry Red
• Sustainability efforts, especially the water and wastewater systems
• The iconic graffiti artwork, “Giga Berlin Casting Pirates” culture, and what it means for the team
• Navigating Germany’s labor environment with IG Metall while keeping Tesla’s speed and intensity
• Key takeaways from André’s recent conversation with Elon Musk
• Europe sales momentum, the “built in Germany” advantage, and what Tesla needs to stay ahead

André also shares his personal message to Tesla owners in Europe and what the world should expect next from Giga Berlin.

If you’re into world-class manufacturing, Tesla’s first-principles approach, or just love seeing how the sausage is made at one of the most advanced car factories on the planet — this one’s for you.
